name: 70774 · Saint Amant, LA
findings: ZIP 70774 (Saint Amant) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70774 (Saint Amant) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
